title: SEBI - 0045/2007 — Gammon Infrastructure Projects Ltd. v. Securities and Exchange Board of India
text:
IN THE SECURITIES APPELLATE TRIBUNAL
MUMBAI
Appeal No. 45 of 2007
Date of Decision 23.3.2007
Gammon Infrastructure Projects Ltd. …… Appellant
Versus
Securities & Exchange Board of India …… Respondent
Present : Mr. D.J. Khambata, Senior Advocate with Mr. P.N. Modi,
Advocates for the appellant
Dr. Poornima Advani & Ms. Sejal Shah, Advocates for the
respondent
Coram:
Justice N.K. Sodhi, Presiding Officer
R. N. Bhardwaj, Member
Per: Justice N.K. Sodhi, Presiding Officer
Heard the learned senior counsel for the appellant and the learned
counsel for the respondent. The issues involved in the appeal require a
detailed consideration. Admitted.
2. We have also heard the learned counsel for the parties regarding the
prayer for interim stay. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the
case, we direct the respondent to reopen the appellant’s file with regard to
the draft red herring prospectus and process the same in accordance with
law dehors the order dated 21.12.2006 to which admittedly, the appellant

2
was not a party and nor was any direction issued to it therein. Since the
prospectus is pending with the respondent Board for almost a year, we trust
that the matter will be processed expeditiously.
Justice N.K. Sodhi
Presiding Officer
R.N. Bhardwaj
Member
23.3.2007
//SR5/7/12 12:39
respondent: Securities and Exchange Board of India
